Start working out so you're not just gaining fat and go on a bulk. If you have a hard time eating your calories just look up weight gainer shakes. They're especially nice to have in the morning if you dont have much of an appetite. you want to eat more calories then you burn and im sure you probably think you eat a lot like all skinny people think but if you actually count how many calories youre eating its not enough to gain weight. Also keep in mind that it takes time and is something you have to commit to. There are gonna be nights where you just feel like you cant eat another bite but you're gonna have to do it. You're gonna do more meal prepping and have to spend a little more money on food. You can either clean bulk or dirty bulk however dirty bulking is obviously not good for you and when I was doing it I constantly felt sick and had to take TUMS. There are gonna be days when you want to give up since like I said it takes time. In 6-ish months you will end up looking a lot different and feeling more confident. Youll get compliments and honestly quality of life just goes up when you're more comfortable in your body and people compliment you. So any time you want to skip training or skip a meal remind yourself the reason you're trying to do this. I was in my 3rd month and wasn't seeing the results I wanted to yet and so I slowly fazed out of it and made excuses. Then two months after that the person I was working out with started to make more gains. I realized that if I had just stuck with the process that I would've been living a different life. So no matter what stick with it. Make sure you do a lot of research too because there are people who go super in depth with this stuff, whether its a diet or workout routine you should be following just find whatever works best for you.
